name: context
description: 上下文工具（action 分派）。action=compact：AI 自主压缩当前对话的上下文（把较早的消息折叠为结构化摘要，缓解上下文占用；运行中也可用）。action=search：检索历史上下文（BM25 智能检索）——scope=current 检索本对话原始上下文（含已被压缩折叠的原文，原文始终保存在会话中），scope=all 跨全部会话检索；可查证此前读过/讨论过的内容。
description_en: Context tool (dispatched by action). action=compact: the AI proactively compacts the current conversation context (folds earlier messages into a structured summary to relieve context pressure; usable while running). action=search: retrieves historical context (BM25 smart search) — scope=current searches this conversation's original context (including messages already folded by compaction; the originals are always kept in the session), scope=all searches across all sessions; useful to recover previously read/discussed content.

focus.description: compact：压缩时的附加焦点（优先保留的内容，可选）
focus.description_en: compact: additional focus to preserve when compacting (optional)

query.description: search：检索查询（自然语言关键词）

scope.description: search：检索范围。current=本对话原始上下文（含已压缩原文，默认）；all=跨全部会话
scope.description_en: search: scope. current=this conversation (including compacted originals, default); all=all sessions

includeCompacted.description: search：是否包含已被压缩折叠的消息原文（默认 true）
includeCompacted.description_en: search: include messages folded by compaction (default true)

includeTool.description: search：是否包含工具结果消息（默认 false，噪声较大）
includeTool.description_en: search: include tool-result messages (default false, noisier)

topK.description: search：返回条数上限（默认 10，最大 50）
